// spirv — the shaders, compiled, as the words Vulkan takes.
//
// GENERATED by `tools/build_shaders.sh <glslang>` (which runs `tools/spirv_tables.py`)
// from `shaders/` — do not edit by hand: edit the GLSL and run the script. See
// `doc/GPU.md`, "Changing a shader".
//
// The SPIR-V is committed so that a program using smalt builds with the Axle compiler
// and nothing else. Words are written eight to a line, as signed decimals: SPIR-V words
// use all 32 bits (the float constant -1.0 is 0xBF800000), and an Axle array literal
// takes its element type from its values, so one word past i32's range would retype
// the table. `GpuCheck::shaders` checks each module's header and size.
//
// Functions returning a table rather than constants: a top-level initialiser must be a
// literal (E0720), and `VkShaderModuleCreateInfo` wants an address the caller holds for
// the length of the call.
//
// fmt: skip — `axle fmt` puts every word of a table on a line of its own.
